materiality_analysis.reason: This row references the pointer to Note 2 for details on Non-Arriver businesses. As the primary discontinued operations disclosure is also removed, the removal of the cross-reference to these discontinued business details further signifies the cessation of that reporting stream. While less standalone material than the operations themselves, it contributes to the overall material change in how discontinued items are communicated.

comparisons.peer_summary: Additional information on cash requirements, contractual obligations, lease obligations, commitments, contingencies, and borrowings is available in specific notes to the financial statements.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures serve as navigational references within Item 7, directing readers to specific Notes in the financial statements for detailed information, rather than providing the substantive data itself. QCOM references Note 2 for details on Non-Arriver businesses (discontinued operations), while AVGO references Notes 14, 10, 6, and Item 8 for contractual obligations, commitments, borrowings, and leases. Both function as cross-references to the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements.
